description: RAVEN_NEARBY_LINK_V1 §5. T is bob's token at e0 (rnb1_tokens_001.json), alice is the central. HELLO = 0x01 || 0x01 version || flags_c || nonce_c || tag_h, tag_h = HMAC-SHA256(K_knock, 'RNK1/hello' || T || flags_c || nonce_c)[0..16]. CHALLENGE = 0x02 || 0x01 || flags_p || nonce_p || tag_p, tag_p = HMAC-SHA256(K_knock, 'RNK1/resp' || T || flags_c || nonce_c || flags_p || nonce_p)[0..16]. PROOF = 0x03 || tag_c, tag_c = HMAC-SHA256(K_knock, 'RNK1/proof' || T || flags_c || nonce_c || flags_p || nonce_p)[0..16]. K_knock is the alice-bob k_knock_hex of rnb1_pair_keys_001.json. The nonces are fixed here; a real knock draws them fresh. silent: HELLOs on the same service, after the one above, that the peripheral does not answer (version other than 1, a tag that does not verify, or a nonce_c it answered before)

silent.what: a replay of the HELLO above
flags_c bit 0 flipped (the MAC covers every flag bit)
tag_h with its last bit flipped
carol's HELLO (no key of this pair)

name: RNK1 knock: HELLO, CHALLENGE and PROOF on bob's service, and HELLOs that get silence
